units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 20a:1">Ab. Zar. 20ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>תחנם</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:2">Deut. VII, 2</cite>) <he>לא תתן להם חן</he> ascribe no gracefulness to them (pay no attention to their beauty).
<cite ref="Sukkah 49b:13">Succ. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>אדם שיש עליו חן</he> (Ms. M. <he>לו</he>; Var. <cite ref="H01334"><he>חסד</he></cite>) a person that makes a favorable impression on men.
<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:6">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>ותנני … לחן וכ׳</he> and let me find grace and favor &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 77b:6">Keth. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>אם חן מעלה וכ׳</he> if the Law makes pleasing those who study it, will it not also protect them?—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:2:2">Y. Gitt. V, 46ᵈ</cite> top <he>מפני חִינָּהּ וכ׳</he> for the sake of her grace (to raise her estimation in the eyes of men), that people may be anxious to marry her; v. next w.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34:15">Gen. R. s. 34</cite>, end <he>שנתן חן וכ׳</he> who made every place attractive to its inhabitants; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חִינּוֹת</he>, <he>חִינִּין</he>.

<cite ref="Sotah 47a:4">Sot. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ ח׳ הן וכ׳</he> there are three remarkable favors, the favor in which the inhabitants hold their place &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:1:3">Y. Yoma IV, beg. 41ᵇ</cite>
